root_cause: The LLM accuracy CPU job fails at pytest collection time before any test runs: importing the pip-installed openvino_genai wheel triggers import of its compiled py_openvino_genai extension, which dynamically links against libopenvino.so.2640 (the OpenVINO runtime shared object versioned by build number 2640). That shared object is absent from LD_LIBRARY_PATH/site-packages in this job's environment, so the dynamic loader fails before any LLM/whowhatbench code executes. This is identical (message, stack, failing module) to the previously recorded pattern a87e95431b0e8175, now at its 8th occurrence across unrelated PRs over roughly 10 days. PR #38430 only touches src/plugins/intel_gpu (GPU scatter constant-layout fix) and its tests, and has no relationship to the openvino_genai/libopenvino packaging path, confirming this remains a pre-existing environment/packaging defect in the LLM accuracy job setup rather than a regression introduced by this PR.
reproduction_steps: Not reproducible from a local source checkout alone. In CI: use the same LLM-accuracy job image, pip install the pinned openvino_genai wheel, then run `python3 -m pytest tests/llm/accuracy_conformance.py --collect-only` and observe the ImportError for libopenvino.so.2640. Locally this usually means the OpenVINO C++ runtime .so installed alongside is a different/older build than the one openvino_genai's binding was built against.
recommended_actions: Fix the LLM accuracy CPU test job setup (job_llm_accuracy_tests.yml) so the runtime OpenVINO shared libraries (build 2640) are built/installed and exported on LD_LIBRARY_PATH/RPATH before the openvino_genai wheel is imported.
Verify version alignment between the openvino_genai wheel being installed and the OpenVINO runtime package produced by the same CI run; pin or rebuild consistently.
Given this is the 8th recorded occurrence affecting merge-queue merges of unrelated PRs, escalate to CI/build-infra owners as a blocking infrastructure defect rather than re-investigating per PR.
prevention_strategies: Add a smoke check step right after installing openvino_genai in the LLM accuracy jobs that runs `python3 -c "import openvino_genai"` and fails fast with a clear diagnostic (missing library path) instead of surfacing as an opaque pytest collection error; add a CI health check that verifies the runtime .so version matches the wheel's expected version before running the full test suite.
historical_context: Identical normalized signature previously recorded 7 times between 2026-09-21T15:45:59Z and 2026-09-23T09:21:50Z (most recent prior run 35832740280, PR #38337), all unrelated to the respective PRs under test, confirming a persistent shared packaging/environment defect in the LLM accuracy job rather than a per-PR regression.
